title: heterotheca subaxillaris
intro: Heterotheca subaxillaris, commonly known as Camptostemum subaxillare or Camptostemum corymbosum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Heterotheca subaxillaris include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, an antimicrobial agent, and an antioxidant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
